about: B1 cross-check (R76). One long-or-flat call per bar, made at that bar's close. The Java engine (NextOpenCrossCheckTest) and the walk-forward scorer (python/tests/test_next_open_crosscheck.py) both read this file and must produce these trades and this return, with costs and tax off. A call fills at the next bar's open; the last bar's call has no next bar and is never filled; a position still open at the end is marked at the last close.

taxed.about: G20: other calls on the same bars, scored at a 25% tax on realized gains, costs off. Two gains taxed at their sale, a loss carried, and the position open at the end sold at the last close and taxed net of the carried loss. The Java engine's PortfolioManager and the walk-forward scorer's profit.simulate_taxed must both give this return and this tax (points of starting capital).
